slot.brief: Ask which among a set of 4 common drugs (aspirin, paracetamol, ibuprofen, morphine) is used as an analgesic and antipyretic but not anti-inflammatory — direct fact recall.

stem: Which of the following drugs is used as an analgesic and antipyretic but has no significant anti-inflammatory action?

verdicts.working: Paracetamol is an analgesic and antipyretic with no significant anti-inflammatory action.

working:
Paracetamol relieves pain and fever by central inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis but lacks anti-inflammatory activity. Aspirin and ibuprofen are anti-inflammatory NSAIDs. Morphine is a narcotic analgesic.

Independent check: Paracetamol is an analgesic and antipyretic with no significant anti-inflammatory action.
solution: Paracetamol relieves pain and fever through central inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis, but has no significant anti-inflammatory action.
